mapper.select: SELECT A.*, M.name AS extra__name, T.tripRegion AS extra__tripRegion FROM article AS A INNER JOIN `member` AS M ON A.memberId = M.id INNER JOIN tripInfo AS T ON A.tripId = T.id WHERE A.id = #{articldId} GROUP BY A.id
INSERT INTO article SET regDate = NOW(), updateDate = NOW(), memberId = #{memberId}, tripId = #{tripId}, title = #{title}, `body` = #{body};
INSERT INTO articleImage SET articleId = #{articleId}, fileName = #{fileName}, contentType = #{contentType}, `data` = #{data}

SELECT A.*, M.name AS extra__name, AI.data AS extra__thumbnailImg, AI.contentType AS extra__contentType, T.tripRegion AS extra__tripRegion FROM article AS A INNER JOIN `member` AS M ON A.memberId = M.id INNER JOIN articleImage AS AI ON A.id = AI.articleId INNER JOIN tripInfo AS T ON A.tripId = T.id WHERE 1
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND A.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND T.tripRegion LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND M.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY A.id

SELECT A.*, M.name AS extra__name, AI.data AS extra__thumbnailImg, AI.contentType AS extra__contentType FROM article AS A INNER JOIN articleImage AS AI ON A.id = AI.articleId INNER JOIN `member` AS M ON A.memberId = M.id GROUP BY A.id
